summary: ST-06 is an empty story: children: [] and no workitems/ directory, and the node self-declares UNEXPANDED ('Explicit expansion task. Split in a future planning session') - the planning contract requires an empty story expanded before acceptance, so this is a split. Its scope inventory confirms non-leaf scope: at least 9 distinct deliverable behaviors (per-band identity dressing across four band groups per section 14.3; the surface cozy baseline and return relief per section 59; debug-geometry replacement plus the whole-game juice list per section 48; flashlight/no-pure-black behavior per section 15; depth-based audio layers with creature vocabulary and sparse music per sections 27/58; camera polish per section 16; the Tab bathymetry map overlay per section 26; accessibility controls with save persistence per section 43; spoiler-safe late-game inspection per section 70) across the 4 named subsystems, far over the three-responsibility leaf limit, and none of the 6 criteria (AC-art-palettes/sound/geometry/contrast/map/a11y) has any child coverage (coverage: false). Findings are otherwise sound: depends_on [ST-04, ST-05] resolves to two already-expanded, reviewed stories (WI-04*, WI-05*); the map overlay's discovered-landmark markers correctly trace to ST-04's AC-enc-story landmark data while its other inputs (discoveredChunks, base, player position) already exist in the baseline simulation; and the constraints are carried (post-processing restraint per section 14.3, presentation-state-only reads per the discoveredChunks pattern with real simulation gaps filed as defects, no new gameplay rules or balance tuning, spoiler rule per section 70 for late-game inspection, extend-not-rebuild on the existing src/render/ toolbox). Adopt the node's own proposed boundary as the minimum 7-way split, each child owning a strict subset of the parent criteria and carrying the assigned parent criterion text verbatim: ST-06a surface+coast band, ST-06b mid bands, ST-06c deep bands, ST-06d final zone (together covering AC-art-palettes and AC-art-geometry, with AC-art-contrast assigned to ST-06a, which owns the surface cozy baseline and the return-relief check using a private fixture without late-game spoiler names); ST-06e audio -> AC-art-sound; ST-06f map overlay -> AC-art-map; ST-06g accessibility -> AC-art-a11y. Each band child must name its scenes, keep at least two differing band attributes per section 14.3, and record its per-band browser inspection evidence, per the node's own note. Cross-child proof ownership: ST-06e owns the creature-audible-before-visible check across all bands; the AC-art-geometry 'all critical-path areas' juice-presence check is a whole-game delivery check, so assign it to ST-06d as the explicit final proof owner (band children verify their own areas; ST-06d does one final critical-path browser pass and reports gaps through the defect route, not scope grabs); ST-06c owns the no-pure-black flashlight proof in the deep bands; ST-06d owns the section 16 scale-reveal zoom for its colossal encounter and keeps endgame presentation spoiler-safe per section 70; ST-06f owns the browser check of the Tab overlay's contents, pause behavior, and absence of creature markers, reading discoveredChunks plus ST-04's landmark data without adding gameplay rules; ST-06g owns the browser save round-trip persistence check for the section 43 controls and the trivial section 42 save-settings migration for the new toggle fields. All seven children inherit depends_on [ST-04, ST-05] (stable encounters before dressing; stable landmark data for the map), and downstream ST-07's performance measurement then means all ST-06 leaves with no frontmatter change needed.
